fonts.usage: Massive headlines, aggressive street-style branding, 'WANTED' posters.
File numbers, timestamps, 'CONFIDENTIAL' stamps, manifest numbered chapters.
Data readout, service descriptions, technical details, form inputs.

rules.headings: Uppercase exclusively for Anton. Extremely tight letter-spacing (tracking).
rules.body: Left-aligned, crisp, high legibility. Monospace adds to the 'tactical radar' and 'typewriter file' aesthetic.

rules.theme: Dark Mode Only. The aesthetic is a dark, moody crime scene/night ops mission.
rules.accents: Use blood red for interactive elements, hover states, and 'WANTED' / 'CONFIDENTIAL' stamps.
rules.contrast: Do not use pure #000000; #050505 provides depth without swallowing shadows.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom crosshair / sniper reticle following the mouse (position fixed, pointer-events: none). Hide default cursor on body.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Overlay a fixed `repeating-linear-gradient` over the hero or radar sections (opacity 0.03) to simulate tactical HUDs.
visual_enhancers.stamps: CSS-styled elements with `border: 4px solid #D90429`, rotated slightly (e.g., `transform: rotate(-5deg)`), with uppercase Special Elite text to mimic ink stamps.
visual_enhancers.security_tape: Diagonal CSS repeating linear gradients for section dividers. Animated via CSS translation to look like a moving police barricade tape.

grids.services_bento: Asymmetrical CSS Grid. Combine tall vertical cards (dossiers) with wide tactical readouts.
grids.dossier_layout: Overlapping elements. Absolute positioning inside relative containers to pin paper clips or stamps overlapping the borders of the 'WANTED' files.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height. Massive kinesthetic typography. Line-by-line masked text reveal. A subtle HUD circle/radar in the background.
layouts.services: Grid of 'WANTED' cards. Each card has a mugshot area (SVG icon), dossier number, and 'Eliminate' button.
layouts.engagements: Numbered manifesto list. Large monospace numbers (01, 02) with typewriter-style descriptions.
layouts.radar_map: Concentric circles intersecting with a stylized SVG map of Île-de-France. A sweeping CSS conic-gradient to simulate radar sweeps.
layouts.pro_space: Designed like a secure 'CLASSIFIED' top-secret folder.
layouts.anti_tariff: Red alert box. 'NO RANSOM WITHOUT PROOF'. Emphasizing free quotes after on-site diagnostic.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis via CDN initialized on the window.
motion.hero_reveal: GSAP masked line-by-line reveal. Use `clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)` or `yPercent: 100` wrapped in `overflow: hidden` containers.
motion.parallax: GSAP ScrollTrigger to move background radar or stamps at different speeds relative to the scroll.
motion.marquee: Infinite horizontal CSS scroll for the 'SCÈNE DE CRIME - NE PAS FRANCHIR' tapes.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons get a 'glitch' effect or scanline flash on hover.

accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by disabling GSAP animations and custom cursors if queried.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure the blood red (#D90429) against black (#050505) meets WCAG AA for large text. Use off-white for body text.
accessibility.attributes: Add `data-testid` to form inputs, submit buttons, and service cards.

media.instructions: 100% INLINE SVGs. ABSOLUTELY NO EXTERNAL PHOTOS. Do not use img tags with external sources. You must generate raw SVG code for UI icons (crosshairs, rats, wasps, folders, stamps).
media.svg_styling: SVGs should use `stroke='currentColor'` or exact hex codes to perfectly match the red/black tactical theme.

3d_libraries.instructions: No WebGL/Three.js required. Create the '3D/Parallax' depth using GSAP ScrollTrigger and CSS transforms on layered DOM elements (e.g., overlapping stamps, moving radar rings).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user explicitly requested a SINGLE HTML FILE (index.html). DO NOT use React, Tailwind CLI, or Shadcn. Use vanilla HTML, vanilla CSS (embedded in <style>), and vanilla JS (embedded in <script>). Import GSAP and Lenis via CDN script tags. Implement the creative 'Scene of Crime / Wanted Dossier' theme using pure CSS styling. Generate inline SVGs for all graphics (rat, wasp, radar, map). Do NOT build a standard generic corporate layout. Inject tension, asymmetry, and raw tactical energy into the CSS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Reject 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered generic boxes, light gray borders, happy emojis). 2. Create extreme tension via high contrast (Deep black vs Blood red). 3. Every interaction needs micro-animations (e.g., typewriter effect on hover, glitch). 4. Use 2x-3x more spacing (padding/margin) to make the text feel monumental. 5. Include `data-testid` on all actionable elements. 6. All images must be INLINE SVG drawn by you, no external images. 7. Do not use transparent overlays that make text unreadable.
